effective_contract_rule: all base-contract requirements remain exact except the named change_scope objects, which are replaced by this closed successor

fresh_hint_v2.admission: strict exact-shape/size/enum/integer validation; validate the renderer boundary against authoritative final message, strict-UTF-8 encode that prefix, and require equality with claimed utf8_bytes before atomic private mint
fresh_hint_v2.failure: all schema/key/enum/type/range/size/boundary/surrogate/scalar/byte-equality failures map to fresh_hint_invalid; never persist or overwrite; ordinary V4/chat/provider/tools/interactions/base RunBundle continues
fresh_hint_v2.fresh_only: fresh composer/edit with positive final template prefix only; no-composer, programmatic, non-fresh, resume, interject, and zero-template-only paths omit
fresh_hint_v2.independent_authority_limit: runtime independently verifies UTF-8 bytes from authoritative message plus validated boundary; template-origin provenance is a closed renderer assertion, not independently reconstructed
fresh_hint_v2.prefix_utf16_units: positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden; JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit boundary within authoritative final message; may not split a valid surrogate pair
fresh_hint_v2.privacy: content-free; no composer/rawText/raw content/command/template/plugin name/toolkit/id/path/URL/digest/hash/arbitrary label/extra key
fresh_hint_v2.source_count: literal 1; one aggregate expanded-prefix contribution record; never command/template/plugin count
fresh_hint_v2.strict_scalar_prefix: unpaired surrogate in selected prefix is invalid; strict UTF-8 only; no replacement encoding
fresh_hint_v2.template_rule: templateLength===0 omits; mixed zero/nonzero expansion represents only the joined non-empty template prefix as one aggregate
fresh_hint_v2.utf8_bytes: positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden; must equal runtime strict-UTF-8 recomputation
fresh_hint_v2.v1_input: unsupported at the v2 boundary; composition-only fresh_hint_invalid; no heuristic upgrade or dual parser

private_projection.output: existing one-item skills/expanded_invocation/messages tuple with runtime-recomputed utf8_bytes and literal source_count=1
private_projection.rule: atomic mint only after valid v2 admission; public v2 and private v1 are distinct schemas; only private v1 bytes participate in durable resume equality
private_projection.schema_stability: private tuple shape remains unchanged and its hint-derived source_count means one admitted aggregate record

successor_availability_reason.privacy: content-free; no message, details, path, id, hash, or arbitrary string fields
